concept.title: Root index or TOC
concept.abstract: This section covers the Table of Contents and Root Index — the navigation structure that maps the publication hierarchy and serves as the converter's primary entry point for building the root DITA map — and two scenarios: a root index file present in the package, and a missing root index file. The converter reads the root index to construct the DITA map hierarchy and topic references; when no root index is present, it falls back to the package folder name or filename as the root map title.

section.p: A table of contents or root index is the navigation structure of a publication. It declares the document's complete hierarchy in one place — the titles, sequence, and parent-child relationships of all sections, chapters, and topics — and provides the entry point from which readers and systems navigate the entire deliverable.
For the publishing system, the table of contents or root index is the structural anchor of the entire output — every generated navigation artifact, including the PDF bookmark.
